probability_note: Default probabilities are synthetic demonstration assumptions, not empirically validated real-world rates. Recorded reviewer outcomes replace them (Beta(1,1) smoothing) once at least min_history outcomes exist for a finding type and evidence type.

corrected_claim_record.label: Corrected or replacement claim record
corrected_claim_record.explains: A correction or replacement link shows the second submission was an adjustment.
corrected_claim_record.supports: No correction exists and both submissions were paid.

remittance_advice.label: Remittance advice
remittance_advice.explains: Remittance shows one submission was denied, reversed or offset.

operative_note.label: Operative note
operative_note.explains: The note documents the additional procedure or complexity.
operative_note.supports: The note does not account for the billed quantity or components.

itemized_supplier_invoice.label: Itemized supplier invoice
itemized_supplier_invoice.explains: The invoice matches the billed items, quantities and prices.
itemized_supplier_invoice.supports: The invoice does not support the billed items or quantities.

encounter_record.label: Encounter or visit record
encounter_record.explains: A visit record documents the service.
encounter_record.supports: No visit record exists for the billed service.

member_confirmation.label: Member confirmation (simulated)
member_confirmation.explains: The member confirms receiving the item or service.
member_confirmation.supports: The member reports not receiving the item or service.

timestamp_audit.label: Timestamp audit
timestamp_audit.explains: The audit shows staffing or a timestamp error explains the overlap.
timestamp_audit.supports: The audit confirms overlapping single-clinician services.

medical_necessity_documentation.label: Medical necessity documentation
medical_necessity_documentation.supports: Documentation does not support the frequency.

ownership_acquisition_records.label: Ownership / acquisition records
ownership_acquisition_records.explains: Filings document a legitimate acquisition or transfer of patients.
ownership_acquisition_records.supports: Records show undisclosed common control with the restricted predecessor.

clinical_documentation.label: Clinical documentation for the billed level
clinical_documentation.explains: Documentation supports the billed service level.
clinical_documentation.supports: Documentation supports only a lower service level.

prescription_change_record.label: Prescription change or replacement record
prescription_change_record.explains: A dose change, loss or travel record explains the early refill.
prescription_change_record.supports: No change or replacement is documented.

contracted_price_schedule.label: Contracted price schedule
contracted_price_schedule.explains: The contract allows the billed unit price.
contracted_price_schedule.supports: The billed price exceeds the contracted price.

medical_record_sample.label: Medical record sample
medical_record_sample.explains: A record sample supports the provider's recent billing pattern.
medical_record_sample.supports: Sampled records do not support the billed services.

referral_documentation.label: Referral documentation
referral_documentation.explains: Clinical pathways document the referral concentration.
